03

Color Palette

A disciplined onyx-and-gold system. Heritage Gold is the signature; onyx and ivory carry the weight. Use gold as an accent and finishing touch — not as a flood.

Onyx
#0A0A0A
Primary dark. Backgrounds, "SOLUTIONS" lockup, body text on light.
Heritage Gold
#B79A5A
Signature accent. The "UMWA" wordmark, rules, key highlights.
Gold Light
#D4B87A
Highlights and gold-on-dark legibility lift.
Gold Deep
#8A6F38
Shadow gold. Depth, dividers, secondary detail.
Ivory
#F5F1EA
Warm light ground. Print fields and reversed contexts.
Stone
#7A7A72
Neutral support. Captions, metadata, fine print.
04

Type System

A refined serif-and-sans pairing for all collateral: Cormorant Garamond for display and headlines, Jost for body and captions. The wordmark itself is custom artwork and is never substituted with these fonts.

Display / Headlines
Cormorant Garamond
Strategy
with substance.
Aa Bb Cc   0123456789
Body / Captions
Jost
Jost carries the working copy — clean, modern, and quietly confident at every size. Set body text at 16px or larger so the brand always reads with ease and authority.
Aa Bb Cc   0123456789

The UMWA wordmark is a custom high-contrast display serif with interlocking M and W forms. It is supplied as finished artwork only — do not attempt to set it in Cormorant, Bodoni, or any system font.

11

Usage Guidelines

Protect the mark. These rules keep UMWA Solutions consistent and unmistakable across every channel.

✓ Do
  • Pair gold with onyx or ivory for maximum contrast and presence.
  • Give the wordmark generous clear space on all sides.
  • Use the supplied logo artwork at every size.
  • Use gold as an accent — a finishing touch, never a flood.
  • Set body copy at 16px or larger in Jost.
✕ Don't
  • Recreate or retype the wordmark in any font.
  • Place gold on low-contrast or busy backgrounds.
  • Stretch, skew, recolor, or add effects to the logo.
  • Crowd the mark with text, rules, or graphics.
  • Introduce colors outside the approved palette.
